Just got home from vape blast, was fun and def worth going more detailed post to follow as Im a bit dehydrated and feel like I took a bath in pg/vg (not recommended btw)...

Next year I think I'll two day it, even though it was a relatively small show there was a shit ton, (literally, one of the brands was Voop Juice) of juice to sample and towards the end between my back bothering me and my taste buds (and lungs, still getting over that flu thing I had a while back still have a nasty cough from it) by the time I got to the last 3-4 rows of booths I was ready to go home and wasn't really psyched to keep sampling.

Lots of really good products, many of em from companies I'd never heard of. Two of what my best finds were Mod Fuel's Thorad, and Captain Obvious's The Breakfast One. FFDA also had a number of badass juices, unfortunately I forgot to go back and and buy a couple bottles and cant remember the names of the ones that stuck out for me.

Mod fuel describes Thorad as "A smooth creamy blend of sweet cinnamon sugar." to me it tastes like a cinnamon sugar cookie, predominantly cinnamon flavor with baked goods notes and a sweet finish (like real sugar sweet not that nasty fake sugar taste) absolutely love it even though baked goods aren't normally a flavor profile I normally go for. Definitely all day vapable. I've found it pairs well with a quality Islay scotch like Ardbeg or Laphraig.

The Breakfast One is your standard fruit loops style juice, but very well executed. I think I sampled at least 10 fruit loops style juices and this was the one that stood out for me. Unfortunately, I only got a small sample bottle of 0mg, so I'll have to be ordering some soon.

Interestingly, I ran into a couple companies that were aging their juice in oak barrels. One of them had both oak aged (steeped normally the same age as the oak aged) and non oak aged versions of their juices and (imo) the oak barrel aged versions were noticeably better, with smoother, more integrated flavor than the non oak aged version of the same juice.

On the hardware front only big name vendor I saw was Volcano, I wasn't able to handle their new DNA200 box (some asshat stole it out of their van last night) but I did get to talk to them about it and liked what I heard. Specifically about the battery, the LIPO pack will NOT be soldered in and while it won't be as fast/easy to change out as 18650s on mods we're used to it's going to be feasible to carry a spare lipo pack to swap out if you run out during the day. They had their Tube Tank Pro on their Lava Tube 3 DNA40 mod. Honestly not a huge fan of either, the tube tank is NOT mustache compatible it is the only tank I've ever tried that every time I used it it tried to eat my mustache which was a bit painful. The Lava Tube mod felt well made and was really nice other than the buttons, the +/- buttons were a split ring surrounding the fire button and I found it hard to not hit them when trying to fire the device.

d23 beat me to the Satoshi Kon reference, but I figured I'd throw out 5cm per second (Byousoku 5 centimeter) cinematography out there too. Very good composition to emphasize emotional and physical distance between characters, which is the central theme of the film.
